body: Hi, it would help, and to avoid removing the "clear" option, I would add a warning that all settings are going to be deleted. For "Reset to default," have it ask if you want to delete the snapshots. That way we would have the three configurations: Apply-Neutral (leaves the snapshots) Reset to default (with the option to delete them or not) Clear: Warns that all the photo settings are going to be deleted and reset.
